sanskrit: tān eva agnīn paricaret yajamānaḥ divaukasaḥ
english: He should attend to those fires to which he had attended as a householder. Desirous of sacrificing, he should adore the deities (according to the rituals ordained).

sanskrit: ātmanaḥ ca pareṣām ca vṛttim saṃrakṣa bhārata
english: Do thou, O Bharata, protect thy own means (of support and of doing acts of righteousness), as also the means of other people's subsistence.

sanskrit: śmaśāne mṛtamutsṛjya dṛṣṭvā kāyamanāmayam | brāhmaṇānāṃ hitārthāya praviṣṭo yogamāyayā || divyāṃ meruguhāṃ puṇyāṃ tvayā sārddhaṃ ca viṣṇunā | bhaviṣyāmi tadā brahmaṃllakulī nāmanāmataḥ ||
english: 46-47. On seeing a dead body forsaken in the cremation ground I shall enter into it and make it free from ailments by means of Yogic Māyā for the welfare of the brahmins. Then I will enter the holy divine cavern of Meru[13] along with you and Viṣṇu. O Brahmā, I shall then be known as Lakulin.
